name: The Glacier Stair
objective: Descend the stair inside the glacier — carved by no human hand — toward the Old Chapel of the Winterheart.
intro: The ice opens like a throat and closes behind you. The stair spirals down, ribbed like a ribcage, and the air is warm. That is the worst part.
dialogue: Krampus Defector: "The descent is suicide. Convince me you're worth following."
Krampus Defector (defeated): "Good enough. Keep your Pokémon close — the cold down there isn't weather."
lore_discovery: The glacier stair breathes. Frost forms in lung-shapes on the walls. The defector joins the player for the descent — the first ally inside the ice.
